# Appendix

## What case databases give you

Case outcomes and judgments.

What did this court decide?

India Kanoon, Manupatra, and others.

::: {.notes}
Backup, after the close. The contrast: those collections answer what was decided. JEM answers whether the body exists, and how it is wired to the others.
:::

## What is hard to find in one place

Whether the judicial entity exists.

<img class="deck-shot" src="assets/deck/image15.png" alt="Article on the delay in setting up the GST Appellate Tribunal">

::: {.notes}
One sentence. Then the counts, if someone asks how big the map is.
:::

## Scale

::: {.columns}
::: {.column width="50%"}
<p class="big-stat">1,117</p>

**Entities mapped.** All 25 High Courts, all states and Union Territories, central tribunals (NCLT, NGT, AFT, ITAT, CESTAT, DRT, and others), quasi-judicial regulators. Zero orphan nodes in `graph.json`.
:::
::: {.column width="50%"}
<p class="big-stat">1,882</p>

**Relationships.** Appointment, funding, appellate, supervisory, audit, complaint, digital, and security links. Typed, and sourced.
:::
:::

v1.0.0, released June 2026. Audits 1–4 passed. QA sprint complete. 746 `judge_strength` stubs. 84 `case_volume` rollups.

Open source, open data. Maintainers: [@dso6060](https://github.com/dso6060), [@Prajna1999](https://github.com/Prajna1999), [@agriyakhetarpal](https://github.com/agriyakhetarpal). Community pull requests are open.

::: {.notes}
These counts are copied from the September 2026 deck. Edit them here when the map changes. They are not read from `graph.json` at render time yet.
:::

## The stack

D3, a Python pipeline, and YAML as the datastore.

<img class="deck-shot" src="assets/deck/image16.png" alt="How the map gets built: write the entity, validate, check relationships, derive scores, build the graph">

::: {.notes}
One line, unless an engineer asks. The pipeline writes YAML. The site reads the graph.
:::

## What we learned

Automation raises recall. Human gates protect precision.

- Roster review for a new kind of institution, not only for schema changes
- Human review for flagged entities

::: {.notes}
The close of the Tiruchirappalli story, if it did not fit in the five-minute build section.
:::
